lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: remember what I told you before?
Uh...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh for crying out loud!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can't you remember anything?
About you trying to buy clothes?
Remind me again?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There you go!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I knew you couldn't have forgotten.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I went to buy clothes, and an employee basically called me fat.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: After some rumination, I contacted Emma,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and you won't believe what happened.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ladies with our kind of figure

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: usually have a hard time finding clothes in normal stores that fit properly.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So I went to a store that Emma frequents,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: and it was unreal.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I tried on all sorts of outfits, and it was like I couldn't even feel them,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: especially around the chest area.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It was as if I was dressed and undressed at the same time.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hehe.
So, did you end up buying a lot of clothes?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Tons.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: In all the latest styles, too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It turns out I wasn't overweight

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: or anything like that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I was totally normal.
Of course. Your figure right now is perfect as is.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thanks for saying that, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're the best.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'll come over and show you some of the new outfits I bought.
Looking forward to it.
